description: arXiv:2607.23976v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Whether a language model agrees with a user depends on how the user asks. We measure this on 106 models with a grid of three wordings and three cues, on 20 personal decisions, counterbalanced over both options and scored by exact match with no LLM judge.
